title: the를 쓰는 경우와 쓰지 않는 경우(2) (Sydney / the Pacific Ocean)
goal: 도시, 나라, 거리, 바다, 강 같은 장소 이름에 the를 붙일지 말지 구별할 수 있어요.

points.title: 도시·대부분의 나라·주 이름은 the X
points.body: Sydney, Melbourne, Australia, Korea, Queensland처럼 도시, 대부분의 나라, 주 이름 앞에는 the를 쓰지 않아요.

points.title: 거리·공원·역·공항·해변 이름도 the X
points.body: George Street, Hyde Park, Central Station, Melbourne Airport, Bondi Beach처럼 이름 앞에는 보통 the를 쓰지 않아요.

points.title: 바다·강·사막·산맥에는 the
points.body: the Pacific Ocean, the Murray River, the Simpson Desert, the Blue Mountains(여러 산이 모인 산맥)처럼 물이나 넓은 자연 지형 이름에는 the를 써요. the Great Barrier Reef도 마찬가지예요.

points.title: the가 붙는 나라 이름
points.body: 나라 이름에 States, Kingdom 같은 말이 있거나 복수형이면 the를 써요. the USA, the UK, the Philippines.

points.title: 유명한 건물 이름
points.body: 박물관, 극장 같은 건물 이름에는 보통 the를 붙여요. the Sydney Opera House, the Australian Museum.

formula: the 없이: 도시·나라·주·거리·공원·역·공항 (Sydney, Hyde Park, Central Station)
the + 바다·강·사막·산맥 (the Pacific Ocean, the Blue Mountains)
the + States / Kingdom / 복수형 나라 (the USA, the UK, the Philippines)

mistakes.why: 도시 이름 앞에는 the를 쓰지 않아요.

mistakes.right: We swam in the Pacific Ocean.
My friend is from the UK.
mistakes.why: Kingdom(왕국)이 들어간 나라 이름이라 the UK예요.

examples.en: We had a picnic in Hyde Park.
Let's meet at Flinders Street Station.
The Yarra River runs through Melbourne.
We went hiking in the Blue Mountains.
My manager is from the UK.
The Great Barrier Reef is in Queensland.
I arrived at Sydney Airport last night.

quiz.why: 해변 이름 앞에는 보통 the를 쓰지 않아요.
도시 이름 앞에는 the를 쓰지 않아요.
States가 들어간 나라 이름이라 the USA예요.

choices: We met in the Hyde Park.
We met in a Hyde Park.
We met in Hyde the Park.
quiz.why: 공원 이름 앞에는 the를 쓰지 않아요.

quiz.answer: The Blue Mountains are near Sydney.
choices: The Blue Mountains are near Sydney.
The Blue Mountains are near the Sydney.
A Blue Mountains are near Sydney.
quiz.why: 산맥에는 the, 도시에는 the 없이 써요.

quiz.answer: I got on the train at Central Station.
choices: I got on the train at Central Station.
I got on the train at the Central Station.
I got on the train at a Central Station.
I got on the train at Central the Station.
quiz.why: 역 이름 앞에는 the를 쓰지 않아요.

quiz.answer: The Murray River is very long.
choices: The Murray River is very long.
A Murray River is very long.
The Murray the River is very long.
I visited the Canberra last week.
I visited a Canberra last week.
I visited an Canberra last week.
quiz.why: 도시 이름 앞에는 the를 쓰지 않아요.

choices: We walked along the George Street.
We walked along a George Street.
We walked along George the Street.
quiz.why: 거리 이름 앞에는 the를 쓰지 않아요.
